label: Updated at 8 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Glover Leads ISCO Championship
items.text: Lucas Glover finished the ISCO Championship at 15-under, winning by one shot over Aaron Wise, boosting his PGA Tour status.

items.headline: McIlroy Fixes Putting Woes
items.text: Rory McIlroy credits putting coach Brad Faxon and a TaylorMade Spider putter for fixing his putting, sharing the Genesis Scottish Open lead.

items.headline: Ryu’s Historic 60 at Evian
items.text: Haeran Ryu shot an 11-under 60, the lowest round ever in a women's major, nearly making history with a 59 at the Evian Championship.
